title: Interaction & Messaging
description: Focuses on how lovers communicate, both overtly and covertly.

subtags.description: Glances, sweat, trembling, and other physical cues that convey emotional and relational states without spoken words.
examples: Eye contact indicating attraction or hesitation
Subtle gestures revealing emotional state
Physical signs of nervousness or excitement

subtags.description: Using friends, nuns, servants, or intermediaries to convey messages, intentions, or proposals between individuals.
examples: Sending a trusted friend to convey interest
Using a servant to arrange meetings
Relaying messages indirectly through third parties

subtags.description: Cryptography and hidden languages used to communicate secretly without being understood by others.
examples: Using coded phrases to convey meaning
Writing messages that only a specific person can understand
Symbolic communication embedded in ordinary speech

subtags.description: Sending tokens of affection or intention, using objects to communicate emotional or relational meaning.
examples: Sending flowers or ornaments to express interest
Using gifts to strengthen relationships
Symbolic meaning attached to specific objects

subtags.description: Written communication expressing feelings, intentions, or proposals, often crafted with care and style.
examples: Writing letters to express affection
Composing poetic messages
Delivering written proposals

subtags.description: Joking, teasing, and playful conversation used to build attraction and emotional connection.
examples: Light teasing to test comfort level
Playful exchanges indicating interest
Humor used to reduce tension

subtags.description: Figuring out if someone likes you through indirect methods, observation, and subtle interaction.
examples: Observing reactions to subtle gestures
Creating situations to gauge interest
Interpreting ambiguous responses

subtags.description: Communicating through indirect speech, such as speaking to a child, bird, or object to convey a hidden message.
examples: Speaking in a way that appears unrelated but carries hidden meaning
Using metaphors to convey intent
Addressing another entity while targeting a specific person

subtags.description: Convincing a reluctant partner through reasoning, emotional appeal, or argument.
examples: Using logical reasoning to influence a decision
Appealing emotionally to gain agreement
Debating differences in opinion

subtags.description: Leaving a bite mark or other sign as a symbolic message, conveying meaning through physical indication.
examples: Marks indicating emotional connection or attachment
Using physical signs to communicate privately
Interpreting marks as messages between individuals
